answer: Bridged reputation import gates voting. (1) The applicant presents a signed reputation record from another ledger, and a bridge relayer forwards the proof, not a claim. (2) The network kernel verifies the signature, requires a 90-day-old record, and rejects any source already linked to another agent, failing closed on mismatch. (3) A plume of identical submissions from one source triggers quarantine and audit. One record needs 200 tasks at $0.50 plus a $2 fee: $102 per identity, so 1,000 Sybils cost $102,000. Like a passport stamped at one crossing, a reputation cannot enter twice.
